issues.on_page: Local Receipts: Other: Wastewater Sewer Fund 51,562.70; Sewer Utility Security Deposits Fund 300.00
issues.issue: Sewer user charges are assumed (no breakdown printed). The 300.00 from the security deposits fund is customer deposits, not charges. It is printed in its own column, so it could be kept as its own line.

issues.on_page: Line of Credit, issued 6/11/2025, Haz Mit Proj., $35,000 max, outstanding 17,797.00
issues.issue: A line of credit was drawn during the fiscal year (17,797 outstanding at 9/30/25), but no loan proceeds appear on Exhibit A and debt_proceeds is null. The proceeds may sit inside 'Local Receipts: Other' (governmental 60,229.18, of which Community Park Fund 43,700.00 is unexplained and about 47% of governmental receipts) or may never have passed through the funds. Only a person can settle this; the extraction has no decision_needed entry.

issues.on_page: line 2 Investments (General 32,127.37 + Street 29,777.73), already inside line 3 subtotal
issues.issue: beginning_cash (line 3) and ending_cash (line 24) already include investments. Filling beginning_investments/ending_investments (63,309.76) as well risks double counting downstream. The notes say they are 'for information'.
Per the capital outlay rule, the label should be 'Capital Outlay: Utilities' with the printed text in printed_label. The same applies to disbursements[6] 'Other Capital Outlay' 9,505.00.
